question: Arvary Pani Sansad is a watershed management programme in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arvary Pani Sansad in Alwar, Rajasthan** have taken up constructions of numerous water-harvesting structures like **percolation tanks, dug-out ponds (Johad), check dams, etc.**
 
• Watershed development is an initiative that evolved over a** period of 50 years** and now identifies the integrated interaction in the middle of numerous** natural resources belonging to a watershed which is a natural phenomenon.**
 
• This make sure least disturbances in the **natural procedures of protecting the environment.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Watershed development mentions to the** conservation; regeneration and judicious** use of all the natural resources mainly **land, water, vegetation and animals and human development** within the watershed.
 
• The scheme of the National Watershed Development Project was started in **1990-91 in 25 States and 2 Union Territories** based on twin concepts of integrated watershed management and sustainable farming systems.**​ **
